llm_response.reason: The website pretends to be a Doctor Martens outlet for Switzerland but is not an official Doctor Martens site, uses significant branding mimicry, offers unusually large discounts (up to 50% off) with free shipping, and lacks any legitimate company registration or contact details in its WHOIS record. These characteristics match the criteria for a fake online shop scam, including urgency tactics, mimicking a brand, and ambiguous privacy and company information.
